description: This Java source file defines the EnterpriseApplication class which serves as the entry point for starting an embedded Jetty server that hosts a web application packaged inside a JAR. The main method configures the server, loads web resources from the classpath, and manages server lifecycle including shutdown hooks.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class responsible for bootstrapping and managing the embedded Jetty server that hosts the web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that setups and starts the Jetty server with webapp context and resource configuration.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Resolves the port number the server should listen on, checking system properties with fallbacks.
